title: Retrieval, LangChain Data Components & AI Security Quiz

questions.question: Which automated metric can help evaluate ranking quality of retrieved items?
questions.explanation: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) is a widely used information retrieval metric that evaluates how highly relevant results are ranked. Token count, HTTP status codes, and embedding dimensions do not directly measure retrieval ranking quality.

questions.question: Which of the following are types of components LangChain provides for working with data? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Document loaders for various file formats
Text splitters to chunk long documents

questions.explanation: LangChain provides document loaders, retrievers, text splitters, embedding integrations, and vector store integrations to build RAG and document-processing applications. A spreadsheet pivot-table designer is not a standard LangChain data component.

questions.question: A legal firm is implementing an AI assistant for contract review. Which security measures are appropriate? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Publishing all contracts to a shared public dataset
Encrypting data in transit and at rest
Implementing access controls and audit logs
Using on-premise or private cloud deployment

questions.explanation: Legal documents contain sensitive and confidential information. Appropriate protections include encryption, strong access controls, audit logging, and private deployment options. Publishing contracts to a public dataset would create significant confidentiality and compliance risks.
